turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
g does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

02:54 AM

I’m sorry for the worry. For UK orders, tracking is normally sent when the order is dispatched.

Standard free delivery on orders over £30 usually takes 2 to 4 working days. Next working day delivery is £4.99 for orders over £30 if the order was placed before 3pm GMT. Orders under £30 have a £4 carriage fee applied at checkout.

You can view the delivery policy here: https://keysafe.co.uk/policies/shipping-policy 🙂
